parse_wikitext_structured: run the wikitext parser on a JSONL input file to extract structured elements and write output
parse_input_into_structured_form: parse a wikitext datapoint into structured elements including title, sections, claim paragraphs, and bullets
split_claim_paragraph: split a paragraph into pre-text and post-text around a given claim text string
seperate_title_and_section_from_text: separate title, section hierarchy, and body text from a SEP_SYMBOL delimited wikitext string
remove_section_markup: remove section markup from text and return a list of cleaned section title strings
